description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) record used to encapsulate the details required to authorize a payment request in the payment service. It includes fields such as merchant store ID, order ID, customer ID, currency, amount, and idempotency key, with validation and schema annotations for API documentation and validation.

classes.name: AuthorizePaymentRequest
classes.description: A record representing an authorize-only payment request with necessary validation and schema metadata.
